headline: Sweeping tax, energy reforms could lift Bangladesh’s GDP growth to 5.7% by FY35: World Bank
summary: The World Bank says sweeping tax and energy reforms could raise Bangladesh's GDP growth to 5.7% by FY35. Tax revenue was 6.8% of GDP in FY25, and capital spending fell to 2.8% of GDP from 4.9% in FY22.
why: The World Bank is a multilateral lender whose growth outlooks inform investor views on emerging markets. Tax capacity and public investment drive long-term growth and debt sustainability.
